Community-run cat welfare · Metro Manila

Every alaga deserves
a home and a name.

Circuit Community – Kapon Alaga Inc. is a volunteer network of rescuers, fosters, and barangay partners running free-roaming cat rescue, foster placement, adoption, and subsidized spay/neuter (kapon) clinics across our neighborhoods.

How adoption works

Five steps from inquiry to welcome home

We move deliberately — it protects the cat and sets the adopter up to succeed. Most placements complete within two to three weeks.

01

Inquire

Submit the online form for the cat you're interested in, including your living situation and household members.

02

Interview

A coordinator calls or video-chats with you about experience, routine, and expectations.

03

Meet & greet

Visit the foster home to spend time with the cat before committing.

04

Home check

A quick visit or photo walkthrough confirms the space is safe — screened windows, no open balconies.

05

Welcome home

Sign the adoption agreement, receive medical records, and take your alaga home with a starter kit.

Rescue & fostering

We answer the call, then find a temporary lap.

Circuit Community responds to reports of sick, injured, and abandoned cats across partner barangays, and relies on a rotating network of foster homes to bridge the gap between rescue and adoption.

  • Emergency intake for injured, orphaned, or maternity-ward strays reported by residents
  • Foster homes provide short-term care while a cat is vetted, socialized, and readied for adoption
  • Starter kits (litter, food, carrier) provided to every approved foster
  • Foster-to-adopt option available once a bond forms

Kapon program · TNR

Kapon is the intervention that actually ends overpopulation.

Our subsidized spay/neuter (kapon) clinics run monthly in partnership with local veterinarians, using Trap-Neuter-Return for community cats and low-cost slots for owned pets in the barangay.

Give

Fund the next rescue, clinic day, or foster kit

Every peso funds vet bills, kapon clinics, and foster supplies — 100% volunteer-run, so nothing is spent on salaries or overhead. Choose whichever channel is easiest, local or from abroad.

A small giftkeeps a colony fed for the week
A medium giftcovers a cat's spay/neuter procedure
